name: figma-design-agent
description: Native Figma Plugin + custom MCP server. ChatGPT -> MCP -> plugin -> Figma Plugin API.

scripts.build: npm run build:plugin && npm run build:server
scripts.build:runtime: esbuild mcp-server/src/runtime/interpreter.ts mcp-server/src/runtime/compile.ts mcp-server/src/runtime/layout.ts mcp-server/src/runtime/algorithms.ts mcp-server/src/runtime/constraints.ts mcp-server/src/runtime/connectors.ts mcp-server/src/runtime/marks.ts mcp-server/src/runtime/visual-presets.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=mcp-server/dist-test/runtime --log-level=warning
scripts.build:plan: esbuild mcp-server/src/plan/planner.ts mcp-server/src/plan/checkpoints.ts mcp-server/src/plan/gate.ts mcp-server/src/plan/tools.ts mcp-server/src/plan/brief.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outdir=mcp-server/dist-test/plan --log-level=warning
scripts.build:test: npm run clean:test && npm run build:review && npm run build:runtime && npm run build:plan && npm run build:code && npm run build:memory && npm run build:transport && npm run build:shared
scripts.test: npm run test:review && npm run test:code && npm run test:ui && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:plugin && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e
